 Missha to make UK pop-up debut as Boots ramps up K-beauty offering 
 Catherine Rowe-Kosary 12 November 2026 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Linkedin 
 WhatsApp 
 South Korean beauty brand Missha is to open its first UK pop-up at Boots’ Cabot Circus store in Bristol from 26-29 November, as it looks to build its presence in the UK market. 
 The four-day activation will focus on the brand’s M Perfect Cover Serum BB Cream Pro, a complexion product combining BB cream coverage with a serum-inspired formula and SPF50.
 The pop-up will give shoppers the opportunity to try the product in person. The BB Cream Pro is available in eight shades, priced at £15 for 20ml and £25 for 50ml, through Boots.
 The move comes as Boots continues to expand its K-beauty offering, having added several Korean skincare and make-up brands to its range in recent years. In October, fellow Korean beauty brand Aestura expanded its UK distribution with a launch at the retailer, a year after making its UK debut at Sephora.
 Boots initially introduced four new K-beauty brands, VT Cosmetics, Purito, Dr Althea and Fwee, online and in more than 80 stores in June 2025 , building on its existing range of Korean brands including Anua and Beauty of Joseon.
 The retailer has also broadened its Korean-inspired offer beyond skincare and make-up, recently launching a Korean Wellness category featuring brands including RIN, PrePear and Seoul Tonic, alongside its own Seoul Bloom and Yongsan ranges and an expanded HABI collection.
